sceneConcept: A weathered fifty-eight-year-old Chinese relay-maintenance worker stands alone against a transparent background. Short salt-and-pepper hair, brown eyes, light stubble and deep under-eye shadows show years of outdoor repair work. His back is slightly stooped. He wears a faded olive maintenance jumpsuit with sleeves rolled to the forearms, repaired pockets, a compact utility belt and heavy work boots caked with dried brown mud. His head inclines and his eyes lower in a long listening pause while both hands remain relaxed at his sides. Soft even frontal studio light keeps the scene entirely mundane. Visual refresh: a moss-green field jacket over mud-stained work clothes with an old canvas tool belt.
naturalLanguageDetail: A weathered fifty-eight-year-old Chinese relay-maintenance worker with short salt-and-pepper hair and a slightly stooped back pauses with his head inclined and eyes lowered, wearing a faded olive repaired jumpsuit and heavy work boots caked with dried brown mud under soft even frontal studio light; a moss-green field jacket over mud-stained work clothes with an old canvas tool belt; the portrait is framed from head to mid-thigh in a strict cowboy shot, with lower legs and feet outside the image.
